blocks.title: Token Management System — control and evidence planes
blocks.note: The fabric routes each decision through the same contract: score with reasons, policy check, human checkpoint where the mandate says so.

blocks.x: Every component in Token Management System — Overview has a contract, a version and a named owner. When something drifts, the ticket goes to a person, not to a committee — that is what the reference architecture is for.

Quanta's discipline is economic: every initiative carries a classical baseline it must beat on identical benchmarks; negative results are documented deliverables. Where solvers win, we industrialize them as services with re-solve SLAs; where they don't, you keep an improved baseline and a revisit trigger.
